bundle.shortDescription: Write Airwaves OS to SD cards and USB drives.
bundle.longDescription: A simple, attractive cross-platform tool to download, write and verify Airwaves OS images for Raspberry Pi, Rock 5B, Orange Pi 5 and x86 PCs — and pre-configure WiFi, hostname, SSH and the update channel for headless first boot.
